goal: When a ga-engine internal check (rlo Guard, sensor threshold, runtime check, budget, policy) rejects an action, the action is not executed; its would-be effect is computed without side effects and recorded as one shadow row, and independent work continues.
why: User 10-06 21:4x: engine rejections run in shadow and only shadow results are reported (option 1: engine-internal only; platform permission denials stop and are reported directly).
acceptance: a rejected action leaves no side effect (no push, no write outside the shadow record)
the shadow row holds actor, action, rejected_by, reason, would_do, evidence
items that do not depend on the rejected one keep running; dependents wait in a SHADOW_BLOCKED state
a platform permission denial is never converted into a shadow row
one structured record format shared with baseline ops/flow/flow.py shadow/1
constraints: spec only: Dev decides method and plan
